Inventory Receiving Register
============================

### INV-00000001-0037
Receiving event INV-00000001-0037 was recorded in Vadodara for a retail deployment. The receiving quantity was 12 units and the declared value was ₹109,229. State: pending. Primary issue: configuration mismatch.
The warehouse verified the purchase order, product code, carton count and physical condition. For serial-controlled goods, the serial capture step was separately verified. A quantity match therefore does not automatically prove serial completeness.
When a supplier sends a near-equivalent model, the warehouse records the mismatch rather than silently substituting the nearest catalog record. Supplier returns and customer returns are separate business processes even when the same product family is involved.
